Calls for proposals

Global Health EDCTP3 invests in global health through funding collaborative research and innovation projects tackling infectious diseases and supporting activities for research capacity building in Africa.

All calls for proposals are published on the European Commission’s EU Funding and Tenders Portal. 

For detailed information on the calls for proposals, check these documents:

Work Programme 2026

Questions and Answers document

Info Day 2026 (recording and presentations)

If you have questions about your application, please applicantsglobal-health-edctp3 [dot] europa [dot] eu (contact us).
